title: Making 2D ORPG alone...with Ai. Showcase: Dualclass!
author: egod
selftext: ChatGPT 5.5 is my goat. Any fans of 2D Online Action RPG? Steampage will be out soon!

comments.author: Danhyoo
comments.body: As a d2 fan this looks cool

comments.author: MightyBig-Dev
comments.body: This is awesome great work. I’m also a d2 fanboy lol. Very impressive use of ai for game dev. I love this sub

replies.author: egod
replies.body: Thanks! Steampage will be out next month! I have to set up the server on toronto CA and ready to log in

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Wish you a zillion sales. I’m in Toronto too 👌

comments.author: Sylvester11062
comments.body: Looks great! I’m also making an ARPG, I have to ask how you got your UI and Assets to look so good? My backend is in a really healthy spot but I have no experience doing UI or Assets/pixel art, how did you get yours to look so good and consistent?

replies.author: egod
replies.body: Pretty much all the style and Ui was made with Sora2 (RIP). But ChatGPT5.5 is now my goat.

comments.author: kavakravata
comments.body: Incredible! How did you make your world? Im struggling hard with that. Creating the world, making it interesting, adding clutter and models. All help appreciated!

replies.author: egod
replies.body: Do like part by part but following the same arts style. Terrain, trees, rocks. Find a good artsstyle and ask the Ai to follow it.

replies.author: irbrandonl
replies.body: Care to elaborate further? This is also where im struggling

replies.author: egod
replies.body: Well, I don't know what to said more. Learn the AI to follow a pattern when you generate image. He will understand at some point and keep doing the same arts style.

comments.author: YYY003003
comments.body: Great job. Its always very exciting. As I am working on something with similar graphics. Can somebody help me with the issue these games have with graphical coherency . Why does even the map and the characters look a little off compared to a regular game. I think it must be very subtle things.

replies.author: egod
replies.body: It's mostly the isometric angle. Always challenging.

comments.author: Duelist_Roger
comments.body: It looks solid, If it's not p2w game in the future I could play lol

comments.author: CharaBlizzara
comments.body: is this one of those build in public with source kinda things?

replies.author: egod
replies.body: No, I made everything from zero, started 2 years ago when AI was weak

comments.author: robertsakkan
comments.body: Why do all of these ai dev games look exactly the same with the most generic looking aasets that lack any sort of character?
